label: None
description: No practical exposure; has not worked with the skill.

label: Awareness
description: Understands the core concepts and vocabulary; cannot yet deliver work unaided.

label: Novice
description: Completes simple, well-defined tasks with guidance and review.

label: Practitioner
description: Works independently on routine tasks and resolves common problems without help.

label: Advanced
description: Handles complex or ambiguous work, reviews others' work, and sets local standards.

label: Expert
description: Recognised authority; designs standards, mentors across teams, and solves novel problems.
